target_customer: Employers and HR teams that must manage health disclosures and disability accommodation requests
problem: Employees struggle to safely ask for and verify workplace accommodations, and employers handle them through insurers, sticky notes and shared drives while needing ADA, EEOC and HIPAA compliance.

founders.name: Hannah Olson
prior_employers: disability employment advisor (per TechCrunch, employer unnamed)
previous_startups: Chronically Capable (disability recruiting platform, launched May 2019, now under Disclo)
founders.background_notes: Inspired by her Lyme disease diagnosis in college per TechCrunch. A Boston University alumni profile exists but was not opened, so education is null.

founders.name: Kai Keane
previous_startups: Chronically Capable (co-built; he was Olson's former boss per TechCrunch)

competitors.name: Inclusively
competitors.what: Workforce inclusion platform (Retain) that centralizes accommodation requests
competitors.funding_then: $13M Series A (date not confirmed from the page opened)

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow software, with added privacy and HIPAA handling for sensitive health data.

defensibility.rationale: Compliance data and HR system integrations create stickiness; the company claims patents. Insurer-run accommodation processes are the incumbent.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TechCrunch in 2023 says larger companies often route accommodations through insurers; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: TechCrunch cites a 61 percent rise in accommodation requests tied to remote work and regulation like the ADA creating compliance pressure.

branding.community_and_virality: Founder appears on podcasts about disability and work and the sister brand Chronically Capable built a community; no merch or meme evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear name that signals disclosure, strong mission story and investor press (TechCrunch, General Catalyst), but no evidence of brand-driven growth.

pivots.from: Chronically Capable, a disability recruiting marketplace
pivots.to: Disclo, accommodation and disclosure compliance software for HR (Chronically Capable kept under the umbrella)
pivots.why: Second venture bringing compliance tools to HR managers per a Mission Driven Business podcast page; launch date from a search summary.

outcome_analysis: Disclo raised a $5M seed led by General Catalyst in February 2023 and claims customers like Meta, Levi Strauss and Lululemon on the YC page. Founders have lived experience and an earlier disability recruiting business, and the rise in accommodation requests supports demand. No shutdown or acquisition found; traction numbers remain undisclosed.
notes: Seed confirmed by TechCrunch, HR Brew and HIT Consultant. Total funding conflicts: TechCrunch $6.5M, HR Brew $6.6M, aggregators $5.1M to $12.2M. TechCrunch calls the company Atlanta-based; YC says Austin. Inclusively competitor date unconfirmed.
